howto: Pick your age band, then Play: Spelling or Play: Maths.
Tap (or Space) to start the power meter, tap again to cast.
When a fish bites, tap as the gold ring meets the green circle.
Keep the fish only if it is the next letter of the clue word (or weighs the answer to the sum); release the rest.
Meet the day's quota before your casts run out, then spend your coins on better gear.
tips: HINT teaches the next step: the first letter and length of the word, the next sound, or a number-line nudge for the sum.
Keeping a wrong fish muddies the bucket and costs 2 coins; releasing it is free.
A better rod widens the strike window; a better lure brings silver and golden fish.
Golden fish are worth five times as much and go on your trophy shelf.
Every two days the words and sums step up inside your age band.

controls.keyboard: Space or click: charge, cast and strike; K keeps and R releases a hooked fish; H shows a hint; P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to charge, cast and strike; KEEP and RELEASE buttons appear when a fish is hooked; HINT sits bottom right.

difficulty: Three age bands (5–7, 7–9, 9–11). Each band has its own range of word and sum tiers, and every two days the questions step up inside that range.

features.age-or-level-bands: Ages 5–7 / 7–9 / 9–11 buttons on the title; the day count ramps the tier inside the band
features.hints: HINT button (and H, and the arcade Hint): first letter and length, next-sound and silent-e nudges for words; make-a-ten, number-line and skip-count nudges for sums
features.grown-up-progress-report: FOR GROWN-UPS on the title (all time) and on the Day Complete card (today): skills practised, accuracy, words to practise and what to practise next
features.tutorial: How to Fish coach on the first day (cast, strike, keep or release, use a hint); skip it or replay it from the title
features.results: Day Complete card: earnings, good catches, muddied fish, coin bank, the grown-up report and the gear shop
